hardware: Intel Arc A770 16GB / Xeon E5-2696 v4 / Windows 10
scope: 36 independent GDN layer commits, HK16/HV48/C10240, capacities 4/6 and all positive accepted counts. Eager host submission to queue completion; no whole-model throughput measurement.
protocol: Shape-local A/B/A/B/A per fresh process; reset/full fingerprint per arm; warmup 3x64 rounds, timed 9x128 rounds, one wait per batch. Core4 affinity, ABOVE_NORMAL; profiling disabled; shared exclusive GPU/compiler lock. Drift<=3%, every shape positive and capacity geometric mean>=1%. Prototype and final helper each screened once and confirmed in two fresh processes. Failed gather candidate has no timings.

preparation.scope: Adopted coop32 baseline versus fixed HK16/HV48/C10240 geometry, and fixed geometry with four-row LSC gather/scatter (16 addresses, four uint64 elements/address). Other geometries use the unchanged generic helper. FMA and reduction order unchanged.
preparation.excluded_before_measurement: ESIMD load_2d/store_2d documented as PVC-only in oneAPI 2025.3 memory.hpp; no A770 2D candidate implemented.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: Two fixed candidates, no resampling. 71 bitwise checks each, shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen. Best eligible per capacity gets two fresh confirmation processes. Each positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Eager timing only, no whole-model claim.

rejected_before_timing.reason: state parity mismatch at T=4 keep=1, first=0, layers=1; six no-op cases passed. No timing recorded.

preparation.scope: Final production FIXED template and dispatch versus the adopted generic coop32 baseline. The final helper and wrapper only change names in the timing object. A separate unchanged production.cpp is rebuilt for GDN regression.
preparation.rule_before_measurement: 71 bitwise checks, one shape-local A/B/A/B/A screen and two fresh confirmation processes. No resampling. Every positive accepted-count shape needs eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), positive pooled throughput gain, and capacity geometric mean gain>=1% in screen and confirmation. Also require the existing multi-geometry commit-layers/window/selftest regressions. No whole-model claim.
